title: Income Phase-Down and Deep-Subsidy Supplement on the Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant
content:
The Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant award carries an income adjustment, worked out differently according to the qualifying income on the loan file — the file's qualifying annual income as a whole-number percent of area median income, as recorded on the borrower's Mortgage Loan File.

**Rule.** Qualifying income above 80 percent of area median income phases the grant down, the income adjustment being minus 25.00 for each whole percentage point of area median income above 80. Qualifying income at or below 50 percent of area median income earns a flat deep-subsidy supplement of plus 300.00. Qualifying income above 50 percent and at most 80 percent of area median income takes no income adjustment.

The income adjustment is added to the grant award with its sign, ahead of the lowering to the program's credit cap and the rounding to the cent.

| Qualifying income (percent of area median income) | Method | Income adjustment |
|---|---|---|
| above 80 | phase-down: 25.00 for each whole point above 80, taken off | minus 25.00 multiplied by the points above 80 |
| above 50 and at most 80 | none | nothing |
| at or below 50 | flat deep-subsidy supplement, whatever the income | plus 300.00 |

### Worked figures (hypothetical incomes)

| Qualifying income | Points above 80 | Income adjustment |
|---|---|---|
| 45 | — | plus 300.00 |
| 50 | — | plus 300.00 |
| 51 | — | nothing |
| 80 | 0 | nothing |
| 81 | 1 | minus 25.00 |
| 86 | 6 | minus 150.00 |
| 100 | 20 | minus 500.00 |

### Basis questions

**Is the deep-subsidy supplement larger for a lower income?** No; it is a flat 300.00 at any qualifying income at or below 50 percent.

**Does the phase-down stop at any point?** The rule sets no stopping point: each whole percentage point above 80 takes off 25.00.
